title: Clean Architecture Layering Enforcement
description:
Enforce clean architecture / open-closed layering across the repo: 🧰️framework (incl. the 💻️os product) must not know ✏️s or any plugin; ✏️s must not know concrete plugins; plugins must not know their extensions. Exhaustive violations audit found: 🧬️schema hardcodes 390 include_str! paths into ✏️s (39 apps); 🔺️mesh/🦀️component.rs embeds ~3500 lines of the 🗄️stdio plugin's format catalog + codecs (incl. a 1225-line DWG codec) duplicating the stdio plugin's own real implementations; 🚪️io/📇️registry/📇️catalog.json is a product-level owner table parked in the framework tree; 6 framework→s Cargo edges (🗺️surface→puzzle, →gis-terrain, os-host/os-flow/♾️infinite/wgpu-renderer→semio-s-3d/2d, ui-wgpu #[path] into ✏️s/🔨️modules/🧊️3d); 🛂️manifest's Contribution enum closed-lists 7 s-plugin topics; os modules (🪐️space, 🔁️workflow, 🏪️store) use s.* schema ids; plugin-registry/build scripts hardcode ✏️s/🔌️plugins, the studio keyword, and "s" defaults (9 sites); 🌀️procedural runtime-links 7 flow extensions bypassing the WIT extension-world (C1/C3 are dev-dep/test-only, C2 is the real runtime violation); semio-framework depends on the os product's semio-framework-os-kernel crate (inversion).

Approach: extend existing open mechanisms (crate [package.metadata.semio] → registry codegen → generated catalogs; string contributes/consumes topics; 🚪️io register_composer_entries/IoRouter; WIT extension-world; .sxt untyped contributions) rather than reinventing. Replace the closed Contribution enum with {topic, payload: serde_json::Value}; evict stdio material from mesh into the stdio plugin (mesh keeps only generic MeshData/Primitives/obj/glb/stl); invert schema registration to per-plugin self-registration; relocate the generic 3d/2d geometry kernels from ✏️s into 🧰️framework (fixes 4 Cargo edges at once); wire WIT extension-world properly and kill procedural's linked-extension fallback; rename os s.* schema ids to os.* and relocate 📖️playbook/🌊️flow cores into their owning plugins; genericize the registry/build/launch.json/package.json pipeline (taxonomy pluginAreas, host key rename studio→shell, DEFAULT_HOST_VARIANT, catalog-injection instead of upward TS imports); add dependency-cruiser + cargo layering-lint enforcement; and relocate semio-framework-os-kernel into 🧰️framework as the true bottom layer. No compatibility layers, no deprecations — old paths deleted outright once new ones land; every s.*-referencing fixture hand-fixed at once.

Full design (Rust mechanisms, TS/build/enforcement, and the 8-wave/~30-agent parallel execution schedule with file-ownership conflict matrix) is written to /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-current-codebase-doesnt-snazzy-dahl.md and its two sibling design files (…-agent-a449167ac23c2ab21.md Rust design, …-agent-aeb00dc5fed1a9bed.md orchestration/conflict-matrix). Execute via a parallel Workflow-tool agent workforce operating on this shared live tree (concurrent human devs + auto-commit bot present — no git writes, no worktrees), wave by wave with verification gates (bun ./📜️script.ts verify gate/verify, cargo check --workspace, plugin-registry check, grep-gates, dev-shell boot smoke, e2e) between waves.
summary:
Enforced the open/closed layering rules across the whole repo (framework must not know ✏️s/plugins; ✏️s must not know plugins; plugins must not know extensions) via a ~30-agent parallel Workflow effort across 12 waves, extending the codebase's own existing data-driven mechanisms rather than inventing new ones.

DONE, VERIFIED (cargo check --workspace clean except two long-standing, independently-confirmed unrelated concurrent issues throughout — semio-compose-rs's pre-existing dsl/vcs errors present in the very first baseline capture; semio-framework-os-kernel-db's still-in-progress "document module" refactor by another live session):

- Geometry relocation: 🧊️3d/◻2d moved ✏️s→🧰️framework, fixing 4 of 6 framework→s Cargo edges at once.
- Registry genericization: PLUGINS_AREA/studio-keyword/"s"-default literals replaced with taxonomy/metadata-derived resolution; dead legacy registry code deleted.
- Open contribution mechanism built end-to-end and fully migrated: closed Contribution enum → open {topic, payload} TopicContribution shape across PluginManifest, ExtensionManifest/ExtensionBundle, ProgramContributionEntry; every real producer (flow x9, cad x4, process x4, sourcing x3, playbook x1, imperative x5) and consumer converted; closed enum deleted everywhere, zero references remain.
- Schema self-registration: all 39 apps across 33 plugins now self-register via the open API; framework's 665-line closed catalog + dead catalog-integration feature deleted.
- WIT extension-world: wired end-to-end and PROVEN with a real compiled wasm component (not just type-checked) - found and fixed 3 real runtime bugs (missing fuel budget, missing epoch deadline, guest init not installing the bundle).
- io FormatCatalog: generic format-metadata registry built; stdio plugin owns its full 28-entry roster; mesh's manifest-vocabulary types relocated into manifest module.
- puzzle (board-2d) and gis (terrain) surface modules moved out of framework - surface module no longer depends on any plugin.
- flow's and sequence's dev-dependencies on their own extensions severed.
- s.*-to-os.* schema-id renaming across space/workflow/store, with one incorrect over-rename (EngineCanvas's plugin-owned play-mode ids) caught and correctly reverted.
- puzzle-5d-react renderer target relocated into the puzzle plugin.
- Enforcement hardened: dependency-cruiser framework-no-s rule promoted to error (zero real hits); 31/33 no-plugin-to-extension rules promoted to error; a new cargo-metadata layering lint added (found a previously-undocumented dead framework-to-plugin Cargo edge, registered as a standalone command pending human triage); taxonomy areas graduated legacy-to-mixed for framework and s-modules (verified zero-behavior-change).
- 15 duplicate package.json dev/build scripts collapsed into the launch.json seed.
- Icon concepts split (generic vs plugin-domain), i18n studio slot genericized to hostApp (one resulting typecheck regression found and fixed).

CORRECTLY INVESTIGATED AND ABANDONED (real architectural findings, zero forced/risky edits):
- Playbook-core relocation: blocked - os-flow's own vcs component depends on playbook internally; 32 files across 4 plugin crates consume it without a plugin dependency. Needs an architecture decision first.
- Flow-core relocation: ABANDONED - the original plan's premise was wrong. The wgpu renderer has a real dependency on os-flow's types; relocating would create a NEW violation. Plugins depending on a framework-owned capability is correct, not a violation.
- os-kernel "inversion": ABANDONED - the whole premise was a misreading. Both crates are framework-role peers; the actual product crate correctly depends on both. No violation ever existed.
- C2 unlink (procedural's 7 Cargo deps on flow extensions, the one confirmed real runtime violation): BLOCKED - needs new runtime infrastructure that doesn't exist yet. Recommended as its own follow-up ticket, built on this ticket's now-proven ExtensionRuntime/WIT foundation.

FOLLOW-UP TICKETS RECOMMENDED: C2 unlink infrastructure; playbook-core relocation architecture decision; cad plugin's own newly-discovered core-to-extension static-import violation; the dead wgpu-to-puzzle Cargo edge triage; full launch.json generation; icon-concepts barrel/Storybook wiring; a large pre-existing dependency-cruiser debt unmasked by an unrelated bunx/TypeScript resolution fix (621 errors across rules this ticket doesn't own).

Interactive dev-shell boot smoke test could not be completed - both relevant ports were occupied by other live concurrent sessions' dev servers; documented honestly with strong alternative evidence substituting for it (full workspace cargo check, the real WASM extension round-trip, registry/dep-cruiser checks).

Every wave's full evidence trail (verify summaries, cargo check outputs, per-agent investigation logs) is in the ticket folder - 114 files.
